scope: Dependency audit and controlled updates — no blind upgrades; targeted changes only with stage-scoped regression evidence.
decision: No bulk dependency upgrades in Stage 53. Current main keeps package-lock.json as source of truth, Node >=22, Prisma 7.8.x and the deepmerge-ts 8.0.2 override. The previously unused passport/passport-discord stack is already absent from current main and is not reintroduced.

contracts.lockfile: package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3 is the install source of truth
contracts.noBlind: Do not bump majors or broad dependency sets without a dedicated stage and regression proof
contracts.securityGate: root npm audit critical/high blocking remains mandatory
contracts.prisma: @prisma/client, @prisma/adapter-pg and prisma remain on the controlled 7.8.x line
contracts.deepmergeOverride: deepmerge-ts remains pinned by override to 8.0.2
contracts.passport: passport and passport-discord remain absent from root dependencies/devDependencies
